findings.motion: SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading, Assembly Floor (passed 57-16)
findings.note: SB 1174 (2024), Elections: voter identification. The bill bars local governments from requiring voter ID or similar identification to vote. Vote taken from the Internet Archive copy of the California Legislature vote page.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Berman Assembly Third Reading, Assembly Floor (passed 60-18)
findings.note: AB 1116 (2025), Elections: voter registration. The bill lets a person without a California driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of their Social Security number plus an electronic signature image. Vote taken from the Internet Archive copy of the California Legislature vote page.
